release_notes: AI assistant chat in the panel: bring your own key (GLM, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama), pick a model from your provider's list, ask for reports or changes in plain words; every change waits for your confirmation. Campaign rules: notify, pause the campaign or switch an offer off in the split when spend, sales or ROI cross your thresholds. Auto-optimisation reports weight changes to Telegram. Text A/B tests on local landings with AI-written variants. Compare with the previous period in the campaign list.
